purpose: One step of a Stepper: its marker and connector, with a title and an optional description coloured by status. Not for standalone use.

notFor.case: Used on its own, outside a Stepper.
A row of a settings list.
A status message about one item.

Status=active.meaning: The step the person is on (aria-current="step").

Disabled.visual: Title and description Content/disabled for every Status.

notes: The active step carries aria-current="step"; disabled ones aria-disabled.

openQuestions: Motion: the State axis has no motion decision and recipes/motion.ts has no entry (finding MOT-002). Should a status change animate?
Disabled drops the status colour, so a disabled completed step and a disabled error step look the same. Is that intended?
